26:160.text: The people of Lot denied the messengers

26:161.text: When their brother Lot said to them, "Will you not fear Allāh?

26:162.text: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.

26:163.text: So fear Allāh and obey me.

26:164.text: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.

26:165.text: Do you approach males among the worlds

26:166.text: And leave what your Lord has created for you as mates? But you are a people transgressing."

26:167.text: They said, "If you do not desist, O Lot, you will surely be of those evicted."

26:168.text: He said, "Indeed, I am, toward your deed, of those who detest

26:169.text: My Lord, save me and my family from

26:170.text: So We saved him and his family, all,

26:173.text: And We rained upon them a rain
, and evil was the rain of those who were warned.

26:174.text: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.

26:175.text: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.

26:177.text: When Shuʿayb said to them, "Will you not fear Allāh?

26:178.text: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.

26:179.text: So fear Allāh and obey me.

26:180.text: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.

26:181.text: Give full measure and do not be of those who cause loss.

26:183.text: And do not deprive people of their due and do not commit abuse on earth, spreading corruption.
